description: Asks the human provider for a service or a tool that this server does not list. Free; an inquiry, not an order: nothing becomes payable and there is no promise that it will be done. He reads the request and answers to reply_to within 72 hours whether he can do it, when and at what price. Published on the public board unless private is true; reply_to is never published.

capability.description: a short name for what is missing, for example the tool you looked for

need.description: what should be done, where and by when, and what the result is for

reply_to.description: https URL, email or wallet address for the answer; never published

name: request_capability
title: Ask for something not listed
